title: SvgSymbol
responsibility: Renders the native symbol element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgSymbol.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet rendered inside the native SVG symbol element when provided; if omitted, it renders no child content. The snippet is invoked without arguments.

outputs.name: SvgSymbol
outputs.description: The rendered value is the native SVG symbol element; props other than children are spread onto that element and provided children render inside it. The component renders no wrapper element.
